intent.raw: Start DomainSpec v2 as a research program: a target-state tower (from NDD) and a spec=ontology unification tower, each run under a two-lane (zig-zag + alternatives) discipline.
intent.objective: Produce source-backed bridge decisions on whether to formalize a buildable target-state artifact and whether to unify spec and ontology into one typed graph for ephemeral implementation agents.
intent.operator_sentence: Run two research towers under the two-lane discipline, then hand off bridge decisions about target-state and spec=ontology unification without promoting anything canonical.

steps.name: Build the target-state research tower (NDD-informed)

capability_metadata.validation_note: Installed generated-native-runtime research-tower skill; runs source-first under v2 research scope.

stop_conditions: block if NDD sources are cited without a date-checked fetch
flag if target-state claims are not separated from DomainSpec readings

steps.name: Build the spec=ontology unification research tower

capability_metadata.validation_note: Installed generated-native-runtime research-tower skill; runs source-first under v2 research scope.

stop_conditions: block if node->pattern is claimed 1:1 without a toy that ran a real counterexample
flag if v1 spec is not path-cited as evidence that nodes/edges already exist

steps.name: Run Lane Z (zig-zag) vs Lane A (alternatives) per tower

capability_metadata.validation_note: Lanes run read-only against tower artifacts and join into one ledger.

convergence_criteria: Lane Z's hypothesis must survive its own strongest counterexample, not just be elaborated
Lane A must attack the underlying problem with a genuinely different solution, not a variant of Lane Z
the join names which problem each lane solved versus only reframed
stop_conditions: block if any lane lacks path-cited evidence
flag if Lane A only produced a variant of Lane Z's idea

steps.name: Synthesize both towers across the two lanes
convergence_criteria: separate target-state-as-narrative value from target-state-as-fitness-function value
separate spec=ontology unification value from generated-mapping value
name the smallest unit worth a later toy or task-session per tower
stop_conditions: flag if synthesis recommends promotion without a bridge decision per claim

steps.name: Adjudicate bridge decisions (borrow / analogy / block / promotion-candidate)

capability_metadata.validation_note: Installed decision-gate skill; adjudicates local bridge decisions only, no canonical promotion.

stop_conditions: block if any decision promotes a template, validator, ontology, or runtime change directly
flag if a promotion-candidate has no named later task-session owner

steps.name: Hand off next move for DomainSpec v2
stop_conditions: do not mutate templates, validators, ontology, or the research-tower skill from this dispatch

gates.condition: Writes are limited to projects/domainspec-v2/research for this program.
Each tower must show a Lane Z idea and a Lane A alternative measured against the same underlying problem statement.
Research evidence cannot promote template, validator, ontology, registry, runtime, or skill changes without a later approved task-session.

subagent_strategy.trigger: Two towers run independently and each tower needs a Lane Z advocate and a Lane A challenger held in tension until synthesis.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Role-bound sibling agents prevent anchoring: a single agent tends to elaborate the first idea, while paired advocate/challenger lanes force a genuine alternative before synthesis.
context: Lane Z and Lane A must not collapse into the same idea (see research/TWO-LANE-DISCIPLINE.md).
Towers are independent and can run in parallel; lanes within the dialectic step are parallel and joined by parent synthesis.
Lanes run read-only against tower artifacts; no lane may promote canonical knowledge.

roles.purpose: Build the tower's hypothesis out by alternating generation and critique until it holds or breaks.
Hold the underlying problem fixed and propose a genuinely different solution than the hypothesis.
Run a research-tower for one tower target, source-first, producing its final learning pack.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Run DomainSpec v2 as 3+ parallel subagents (two tower builders, then paired Lane Z / Lane A per tower), joined by parent synthesis, writing only under projects/domainspec-v2/research. Approve delegated execution?

boundaries.contract: This program writes only research artifacts under projects/domainspec-v2/research.

authority.promotion: DomainSpec v2 owner after later decision

promotion_splits.target: DomainSpec canonical template, validator, ontology, runtime, or research-tower skill

promotion_guardrails: Tower research and bridge decisions are local, not canonical promotion.
Template, validator, ontology, runtime, and research-tower skill mutation require a later task-session.
The research-tower skill is a generated package; do not edit it from this dispatch.
